maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from engineering and scientific consulting such as failure analysis and regulatory work, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mostly private companies, law firms and insurers buying consulting; government is a minor share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically by hiring credentialed consultants and expanding practices; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Project-based consulting and expert work; clients can hire another consulting firm for the next engagement without major disruption.
